h: Nathaniel Bassey's purity pledge call trends as Hallelujah Challenge participants react
p: Gospel minister Nathaniel Bassey's call for a purity pledge has reportedly become a talking point online. Participants in the Hallelujah Challenge have been sharing their reactions, with some embracing the call and others debating it.
more: Many participants shared their own faith goals after the call.
Bassey had earlier asked followers about their faith projects, drawing a wave of replies.
